The information provided here was last revised in May 2024. Important Information on Usage: 4. This document is a summary and does not include all possible information about this product. 5. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. 6. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice and does not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. 7. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Uses: 8. This product is used to relieve symptoms of excess gas caused by swallowing air or consuming certain foods or infant formulas. 9. Always check the ingredients on the label, even if you have used the product before, as the manufacturer may have changed the formulation. 10. Products with similar names may contain different ingredients intended for different purposes. How to Use: 11. Follow all directions on the product packaging. 12. If prescribed by a doctor, administer the medication exactly as directed. 13. Administer this product orally, usually as needed after meals and at bedtime. 14. The dosage is determined based on your child’s age, medical condition, and response to treatment. 15. Do not increase the dose or administer this product more frequently than directed. 16. Shake the container well before each use. 17. Measure the dose carefully using a special measuring device or dropper. 18. Do not use a household spoon, as it may result in an incorrect dose. 19. Administer the liquid slowly, aiming for the side of the inside cheek to prevent spitting or choking. 20. The dosage may also be mixed with 1 ounce (30 milliliters) of cool water, infant formula, or juice. Mix well and administer the liquid immediately. Side Effects: 21. Simethicone generally has no side effects. 22. If a doctor has directed you to administer this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefit to your child outweighs the risk of side effects. 23. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. 24. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. 25. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. 26. In Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: 27. Before administering simethicone, inform the doctor or pharmacist if your child is allergic to it or has any other allergies. 28. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. 29. This form of simethicone is not typically used by adults. 30. It is unlikely to be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: 31. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. 32. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. 33. Maintain a list of all the products you use (including prescription/non-prescription drugs and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 34. Simethicone can decrease the absorption of thyroid medications, such as levothyroxine. Overdose: 35. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. 36. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. 37. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222 for poison control assistance. Missed Dose: 38. If your child is taking this product on a regular schedule and misses a dose, administer it as soon as you remember. 39. If it is near the time of the next dose, skip the missed dose. 40. Administer the next dose at the regular time. Storage: 41. Store the product at room temperature, away from moisture, heat, and light. 42. Do not freeze the product. 43. Do not store it in the bathroom. 44. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Final Note: 45. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete and personalized medical advice.
